content:
BIOSTAR BIWCL-PAT is a 3.5-inch industrial SBC built around the Intel Core Series 3 “Wildcat Lake” SoC family, ranging from the Core 3 304 to the Core 7 360. The board supports up to 64GB DDR5-6400 memory, three independent displays, and dual 2.5GbE networking. It also features three M.2 slots for NVMe storage, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and 4G/5G cellular connectivity, along with USB 3.2 ports, four serial interfaces, and an 8-bit digital I/O header. The compact 148 x 102mm form factor makes it suitable for industrial automation, edge computing, AIoT, human-machine interfaces (HMI), and POS/kiosk applications. BIOSTAR BIWCL-PAT specifications: Wildcat Lake SoC (one or the other) Intel Core 3 304 penta-core CPU with 1x P core @ 1.5 GHz / 4.3 GHz (Turbo) and 4x LPE cores, 1-core Intel Xe3 Graphics @ 2.3 GHz; TDP: 15W Intel Core 3 305 hexa-core CPU with 2x P cores @ 1.5 GHz / 4.3 GHz [...]
